dogecoin.text: @elonmusk Elon, the White House’s loyal dog, Hurricane, has passed away at the age of 16. If someone created a ‘Hurricane’ token, would this be Dogecoin’s new rival? Or maybe he could have been SpaceX’s first astronaut dog… But perhaps the best outcome would be investors using this moment
